column1: # K-Line Dash: Honda/Acura manufacturer-specific trouble code meanings
#   - description: our own short wording of the Honda/Acura meaning of a P1xxx code.
#   - note: a short first check, only where sources widely agree; empty otherwise.
# Curated selection, not an import. A code is listed only if at least two independent publications agree
# on its meaning; codes where sources disagree were left out. Per-code sources: docs/research/dtc-sources-vag-honda.md
# Sources (publications; the two Honda pages that share wording count once):
#   TC  troublecodes.net, entries labelled Honda/Acura: https://www.troublecodes.net/p1codes/
# Not used: the "Acura" lists of carvitas.com and icarsoft.com, which are an Audi/VW table under an Acura title.
# Honda lists the A/F sensor codes (P1162-P1167) as primary O2 or A/F sensor depending on the model.
